page.notes: Index page; the two columns run in parallel and are transcribed row by row, left entry then right entry. Several page numbers at the margins of rows and the exact dot leaders are not fully legible at this scan resolution, and the column split of some entries (e.g. "tifico Rom. ádornatus", "Mánheimi captum pont.") is uncertain. Letters in the lower lines are blurred by show-through and may not be exact. No page number is printed. The last line, cut at the foot, is likely the start of "Mariæ" and is given as printed.
